craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of joined debate — Sāṅkhya fairly stated then page-turned. Ever-becoming moved only by striving; no-mover-but kept. Rejected: (a) mover→cause → killed: mover moves. Read aloud: HENCE in-DEED … BUT-per-son-AIM-striv-ING.

lines: Hence indeed, for ever-becoming pradhāna, no mover
l4.sanskrit_cite: ata eva pradhānasya mahattvapariṇāminaḥ nimittakāraṇaṃ nānyatpuruṣārthodyamādṛte

reads_against.argmap: What moves pradhāna? → Only person-aim-striving moves ever-becoming pradhāna.
c1_essence: Sāṅkhya stated at full strength: pradhāna proved by presence, purposed by denying self-aims; change easy; only striving moves; nature faces down (vv19-22).
The page turns on admitted karma: where is His business? Let His triggering be conceived; seed imaged; Sāṅkhya godless; conditional close (vv23-27).
